title: Epic: Modularize monolithic HTML into a TypeScript app
body:
Current app is a single static HTML with inline JS/CSS and global state. Migrate to a modular TypeScript app with proper state management and build tooling.

Acceptance criteria:
- Vite + TypeScript + ESLint + Prettier set up
- React (or Vue) scaffolded with Leaflet
- Map initialization, layers, and controls refactored into modules
- No global variables; state is explicit and typed
- Inline CSS/scripts removed from HTML

title: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript + ESLint + Prettier
body:
Initialize a modern toolchain to replace monolithic HTML.

Done when:
- Vite app with TypeScript compiles and serves
- ESLint + Prettier configured
- npm scripts: dev, build, lint, format

title: Create React app shell with Leaflet map component
body:
Introduce React and move map initialization into a `MapView` component.

Done when:
- React router or simple shell renders a `MapView`
- Leaflet map renders and centers as before
- No global `map` variable

title: Move inline CSS and third-party styles to bundled assets
body:
Extract inline CSS and CDN CSS to local, versioned assets. Consider Tailwind with purge for size.

Done when:
- No style tags in HTML
- Styles live in `src/styles` or Tailwind
- Build outputs minified CSS

title: Bundle dependencies locally and pin versions (no CDNs)
body:
Replace CDN script/style tags with npm dependencies bundled via Vite. Pin exact versions.

Done when:
- All JS/CSS libs imported from node_modules
- Lockfile committed
- Build succeeds without external CDNs

title: Epic: Data management and performance
body:
Large GeoJSON embedded inline causes slow initial load. Offload to external files or API, load on demand, and consider tiling/spatial indexing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Building data loads asynchronously
- Loading and error states shown
- Optional: windowed/visible-only fetches or vector tiles

title: Externalize building GeoJSON and load via fetch()
body:
Move embedded building GeoJSON into a separate file or endpoint. Load asynchronously with streaming where possible.

Done when:
- No inline building data in HTML
- Data fetched at runtime with progress/loader
- Errors handled with retry/toast

title: Introduce named LayerGroups and avoid map.eachLayer()
body:
Group layers into named `L.LayerGroup`s for controlled iteration and simpler logic.

Done when:
- Building features live under a `buildingsLayer` group
- Selection iterates only relevant layers

title: Investigate vector tiles or spatial index for large datasets
body: Evaluate serving buildings via vector tiles (e.g., PMTiles) or a database with spatial index (PostGIS/Cloud SQL/Firestore geo). Provide a short ADR with findings.

title: Epic: Selection and editing UX
body: Refactor selection logic, integrate Leaflet.draw controls, handle MultiPolygons properly, and add export improvements.

title: Refactor selection using @turf/turf with robust geometry handling
body:
Replace ad-hoc `turfify` and `map.eachLayer()` approach with typed helpers that handle Polygon/MultiPolygon/FeatureCollection.

Done when:
- Selection works for MultiPolygons
- Logic lives in reusable module or hook
- Tests cover intersection edge cases

title: Integrate Leaflet.draw and improve draw/select controls
body: Use Leaflet.draw for drawing and editing selection shapes. Ensure clear affordances and delete/edit actions.

title: Replace alert() with toasts/modals and proper error handling
body: Swap `alert()` calls for non-blocking toasts/modals. Centralize error handling for network and user errors.

title: Export dialog: choose filename and format (GeoJSON, KML)
body: Add export dialog to select filename and format. Disable export when no features.

title: Epic: Mobile and accessibility
body: Make UI responsive with touch-friendly controls and keyboard/ARIA support. Lazy-load heavy modules.

title: Responsive layout for map and controls
body: Ensure map fills viewport, controls adapt to small screens, and touch gestures work for pan/zoom/select.

title: Keyboard navigation and ARIA labels for controls
body: Add tab order, focus styles, and ARIA labels for selection/draw/export controls.

title: Lazy-load measurement and other heavy tools
body: Defer loading Leaflet.measure and similar tools until requested to reduce initial bundle size.

title: Epic: Security, resilience, and offline
body: Pin dependencies, add CSP, improve error handling, and support offline caching via a service worker.

title: Add strict Content-Security-Policy and remove unsafe-inline
body: Define a restrictive CSP for scripts/styles/images and eliminate inline scripts/styles via bundling.

title: Add service worker (Workbox) for offline caching
body: Use Workbox to precache app shell and cache data assets for resilience and offline use.

title: Handle network failures with retries and user feedback
body: Add centralized fetch helpers with timeouts, retries, and toast notifications for failures.

title: Epic: Testing and CI
body: Add unit tests for selection/export, e2e UI tests, and CI for lint/test/build.

title: Unit tests for selection and export logic (Jest)
body: Cover intersect filter and export serialization with Jest. Include edge cases and invalid input handling.

title: E2E tests for draw/select/export (Playwright or Cypress)
body: Automate flows: draw polygon, select buildings, clear, export with filename.

title: GitHub Actions: lint, test, build
body: Set up CI pipeline to run ESLint, Prettier check, unit tests, and build on PRs.

title: Implement file import (GeoJSON/KML) with validation
body: Allow users to import local GeoJSON/KML, validate schema/geometry, and add to a layer group.

title: Geometry editing: enable vertex/shape edits on features
body: Support editing geometries with Leaflet.draw edit mode and persist changes to export.

title: Auto-carryover fields on edits
body: When editing or creating features, carry over configured attribute fields as defaults.

title: Dynamic schema updates for feature properties
body: Allow schema to evolve via a config file, updating forms and validation dynamically.

title: Search: find buildings by name/ID or spatial query
body: Add a search box to locate buildings by text or filter by attributes; pan/zoom to result.

title: Access control: optional auth and role-based permissions
body: If editing is restricted, add authentication and roles to gate editing/export features.
